name: read_report
description: Read an existing private report as historical structured data, without rerunning models. Obtain its run/artifact IDs from user references or authorized read_history. Generated time and source data_as_of are distinct; history never proves current facts. Reuse returned evidence_id with read_result to page.

run_id.description: UUID of the historical run from a user reference or read_history.

artifact_id.description: Existing rp_ report artifact ID belonging to that historical run; never guess it.

section.description: summary for provenance and overview, topics for top-level findings, observations for retained batch viewpoints; default summary.

offset.description: Zero-based section offset; continue using the returned next_offset.

limit.description: Maximum section records per page, from 1 to 10; default 10.
